# Trading Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the Trading department in the whole system: how well quantitative analysis, DeFi, token research, technical analysis, and trading discipline hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- Quantitative analysis and backtests
- DeFi and on-chain data
- Token research
- Technical analysis
- Trading discipline and broker execution
- Risk sizing and position limits

## What is in place
- [ ] Skill that pulls exchange data for analysis
- [ ] Backtests recorded and repeatable
- [ ] Risk sizing on every position, with a recorded limit
- [ ] Entry checklist completed before any entry
- [ ] Orders placed only with recorded approval
- [ ] Record of trades, backtests, and research in one place

## Gaps
- [ ] Signals with no risk measure behind them
- [ ] Backtests that cannot be repeated
- [ ] Entries with no completed checklist
- [ ] Orders with no recorded approval
- [ ] Positions sized without a limit
- [ ] Trading notes living in scattered files

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real analysis or trade review and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
